request: Use an external dependency to detect whether output goes to an interactive console, and remove the language runtime's built-in check, so we can support older compilers.

source.request: Use an external dependency to detect whether output goes to an interactive console, and remove the language runtime's built-in check, so we can support older compilers.
source.settled: grep-cli replaces the unmaintained atty dependency with std::io::IsTerminal.
source.why: Moving console detection back to an external dependency reverses the move to the standard-library implementation.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
